title: Expedition Flight Itinerary Reconstruction
description: An adventurer kept a disorganized log of flight tickets during a global expedition. Each ticket is represented as a pair of boarding passes [from, to], detailing the departure and arrival airports. Reconstruct the complete flight itinerary in order. All of the tickets belong to a person who departs from "JFK" (always the starting airport). If there are multiple valid itineraries, you should return the itinerary that has the smallest lexical order when read as a single string.
constraints: from_i and to_i consist of uppercase English letters.
It is guaranteed that the user has at least one valid itinerary, and they must use all tickets once.
input_format: A 2D array of strings tickets representing departure and arrival airports.
output_format: A list of strings representing the valid itinerary airports in order.

examples.explanation: The only valid itinerary visiting all airports starting from JFK.
Another valid itinerary exists, but this one is lexicographically smaller.
Follows the valid Eulerian path using all provided tickets.
